content: SQLite creates database files with SQLITE_DEFAULT_FILE_PERMISSIONS 0644 further masked by the process umask, so under the common umask 022 the file lands 0644 and is world-readable. WAL and SHM files inherit the main database's mode (0600 db yields 0600 -wal/-shm). Two supported ways to get 0600: pre-create a zero-length file with the mode you want before sqlite3_open, or set umask 0177/0377 around the open and restore it. Restricting the containing directory (0700) is the other lever and is often easier in runtimes with no chmod binding (dart:io has none).
